correctness.rationale: Finite face enumeration yields f=(16,72,96,16). The connected 1-skeleton has d1 rank 15, the two exact mod-two boundary ranks are 57 and 16, and chain-complex inequalities force these same exact rational ranks, proving rational H2 dimension 23 alone. The 192-element affine action is shown full using the six-cycle neighborhood and distinct remaining vertex incidence patterns. Two independently implemented signed-face and vertex-orbit Lefschetz calculations agree on each element; exact fourth-root Fourier projections give the stated four dual orbits and little-group characters. The embedded standalone verifier was executed from its actual draft file and independently replayed after source changes. Neither finite sampling nor unverifiable log-only assertions are used; rational, not integral, representation is asserted.

value.rationale: The Shrikhande graph is the unique exceptional strongly regular graph sharing parameters (16,6,2,2) with the four-by-four rook graph. Its full symmetry module is a canonical invariant beyond the already known 23-dimensional Betti number: translations leave a two-dimensional homology space invariant while the complete group leaves none, and the four character-orbits separate five inequivalent complex irreducibles. A full natural automorphism character answers a motivated finite equivariant-topology question; no broader or downstream theorem is claimed.
